guide.title: Arthas's Overview
guide.text:
Arthas is a Tank who relies on Roots and
Slows to peel for his team or to stop enemy
Heroes from retreating. This type of crowd-control is great
against melee Heroes that rely on Basic Attacks and lack mobility.

guide.title: Arthas's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Powerful crowd control
Good self-sustain
Counters melee Heroes that rely on Basic Attacks
Solid damage output
Durable against burst damage
Weaknesses
Weak engage with Howling Blast
No mobility
Weak to Displacement effects
Consumes a lot of Mana with Frozen Tempest
Suffers against healing reduction effects
Weak to kite

guide.title: Arthas's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Arthas synergizes with
Arthas pairs well with Heroes who can either follow-up on his
crowd control (such as Chromie
with A Proper Greeting) or initiate with their own
(for example Maiev), especially if your main Tank
does not provide enough crowd control for peeling
(Stitches comes to mind).
Heroes who can give him some mobility
(for example Zarya with Speed Barrier at Level 4)
and/or help him survive through burst damage
definitely help (such as Medivh).
Arthas is countered by
Arthas, due to his lack of mobility gets easily
countered by Displacement effects (such as
Wrecking Ball by Garrosh).
He also suffers against
burst damage usually coming from Mages
(for example Kel'Thuzad), healing reduction effects (such as
Emerald by Deckard Cain), high range (Hanzo
comes to mind), Slow effects (for example Jaina),
and high mobility (such as Zeratul played correctly).

guide.title: Arthas's Maps
guide.text:

Arthas's weaker maps
Due to Frozen Tempest being heavy on Mana consumption,
Arthas suffers on Maps where he needs to stay active for long periods of time
(with Braxis Holdout being the major offender) and does not shine
on Maps where it is highly preferred to have your Offlaner
take care of 2 lanes by double soaking (for example
top-mid on Towers of Doom).
While being decent at it, Arthas does not excel at capturing Camps
and/or defending enemy Mercenaries in lane, making him a suboptimal pick on Maps
where macro is important (for example Garden of Terror).

guide.title: Arthas's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Death Coil can be used on enemies to damage them or on Arthas to heal him, something that can be done faster by using the Self Cast Modifier [Alt] rather than by mouse-hovering Arthas.
Howling Blast being a slow projectile requires you to predict the movements of enemy Heroes.
Frozen Tempest reduces both Movement Speed and Attack Speed of enemy Heroes, making it particularly effective against melee Heroes who rely on Basic Attacks.
Frostmourne Hungers resets the cooldown of your Basic Attack, so try to use it immediately after a Basic Attack goes off.
Army of the Dead can heal you on cooldown if you press R to cast it, then press and hold R for its duration.
Summon Sindragosa disables enemy Structures, excluding Healing Fountains, which can make it a very potent ability to use during pushes.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Arthas's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Arthas can be played either as a Tank or as
an Offlaner. In either case, he is being drafted
to shut down melee Heroes with low mobility
and to punish enemy Heroes who have a way to engage but not to get out.
As a Tank, he is quite durable and excels in prolonged
team fights against melee Heroes but cannot interrupt
enemy casts. He can use Roots and Slows
to peel for his team or to stop enemy Heroes from retreating.
As an Offlaner, he has good waveclear
and self-sustain but cannot capture Mercenary Camps.
He can use Roots and Slows to punish
melee Heroes who get too close to him in lane.

abilities.title: Arthas's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Death Coil can be used on enemies to damage them or on Arthas to heal him, something that can be done faster by using the Self Cast Modifier [Alt] rather than by mouse-hovering Arthas.
Howling Blast being a slow projectile requires you to predict the movements of enemy Heroes.
Frozen Tempest reduces both Movement Speed and Attack Speed of enemy Heroes, making it particularly effective against melee Heroes who rely on Basic Attacks.
Frostmourne Hungers resets the cooldown of your Basic Attack, so try to use it immediately after a Basic Attack goes off.
Army of the Dead can heal you on cooldown if you press R to cast it, then press and hold R for its duration.
Summon Sindragosa disables enemy Structures, excluding Healing Fountains, which can make it a very potent ability to use during pushes.

abilities.title: Death Coil
abilities.text:
Death Coil
(Q)
Arthas
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 9 seconds
Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage to target enemy.
Can be self-cast to heal for 275 (+4% per level) Health.
Death Coil is a versatile Basic Ability
that can be used to either damage an enemy Hero or to heal Arthas.
When you want to target yourself, you can use the Self Cast Modifier [Alt]
instead of mouse-hovering your Hero.
When playing as Offlaner,
it is usually better to cast this Ability on yourself in order
to restore lost Health. When playing as Tank,
you will have more opportunities to use it offensively but you should
heavily prefer to use it defensively when getting low on Health.

abilities.title: Howling Blast
abilities.text:
Howling Blast
(W)
Arthas
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 (+4% per level) damage.
Howling Blast is a Basic Ability that provides
crowd control to Arthas, something that can be used
to either engage or peel.
While this effect can hit multiple Heroes, it is perfectly fine to hit
a single Hero with it.
A good Arthas should usually look for a flank rather than
a frontal engage, however, sometimes you can still try to catch enemy Heroes
with Howling Blast from distance. Just make sure
that your teammates are ready to follow-up
(in range and with cooldowns up) before going for an aggressive play.

abilities.title: Frozen Tempest
abilities.text:
Frozen Tempest
(E)
Arthas
Mana: 13 per second
Cooldown: 1 seconds
Deal 36 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.
Frozen Tempest is a toggleable Basic Ability that Slows
enemies (not only Heroes) and reduces the Attack Speed of enemy Heroes within 3.5 range.
Both effects get more powerful each second a given enemy stays within range,
reaching the maximum value after 4 seconds. Howling Blast
helps with that because it ensures that the enemy stays nearby for a few seconds.
The constant Slow is useful for chasing
and—more importantly—for peeling away melee Heroes.
The constant Attack Speed reduction is good against Heroes that heavily focus on
Basic Attacks to deal damage. Therefore, this Ability is particularly
effective against Heroes with both those characteristics: melee Heroes who focus
on Basic Attacks (such as Kerrigan or Thrall).
Mana management is important because you cannot use Abilities without it.
While this Ability offers value in all scenarios, if Arthas uses it imprudently,
he will find himself low on Mana very quickly. You generally want to have
Frozen Tempest active only when damaging enemy
Heroes, multiple Mercenaries, a full wave of Minions,
and high-priority Monsters. If your Mana is getting low,
you should deactivate Frozen Tempest so that
you can at least cast other Abilities, which are more impactful.
Being an area of effect Ability,
Frozen Tempest can also be used to hit hidden Summons on the ground
(such as Creep Tumor by Zagara)
or to get nearby enemy Heroes out of Stealth.

abilities.title: Army of the Dead
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Army of the Dead
(R)
Arthas
Heroic
Charges: 6
Recharge Time: 18 seconds
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.
Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.
Army of the Dead is a defensive Heroic Ability that,
after consuming all charges available, summons up to 6 Ghouls that follow Arthas.
The number of Ghouls summoned is equal to the amount of charges available
when casting it. They will fight at his side and can be sacrificed to heal Arthas.
This defensive effect turns Arthas into an extremely durable
frontline Hero, unless the enemy team
has healing reduction effects and/or brust damage to drastically
reduce its effectiveness.
When active, Arthas will gain access to Sacrifice. Using it will sacrifice the Ghoul
with the lowest amount of Health and heal Arthas by a considerable amount
(similarly to when self-casting Death Coil). Sacrifice
starts on a 1.5-second cooldown and has 2-second cooldown between uses. Even though it
cannot be used when having full Health, you should still avoid using it when
almost full Health to avoid overhealing.

abilities.title: Summon Sindragosa
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Summon Sindragosa
(R)
Arthas
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.
Summon Sindragosa is an offensive Heroic Ability that,
if aimed and timed correctly, can single-handedly decide the outcome of a team
fight by Slowing multiple enemy Heroes and allow your team
to easily engage them without being scared of enemy Structures nearby.
Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters caught in the way will be Stunned.
The first thing an Arthas player has to take into account is its
cast time of 0.6 seconds,
which requires you to think ahead before actually
casting the Ability in order to increase your chance to hit enemy Heroes
and/or to avoid being interrupted by them.
When you want to play aggressively in enemy territory, do not be scared of enemy
Structures because they will be disabled for 20 seconds, a powerful effect to
further increase the advantage after winning a single-lane Objective (such as
the Immortal on Battlefield of Eternity) because disabled Structures
cannot deal any damage.
Due to being Invulnerable,
Healing Fountains cannot be disabled by this kind of effects.

abilities.title: Frostmourne Hungers
abilities.text:
Frostmourne Hungers
(D)
Arthas
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71 (+4% per level) bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.
Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.
Frostmourne Hungers is a Trait that can be activated
to deal bonus damage and restore Mana upon hit. Once activated, it stays on hold
until you Basic Attack someone, then it goes on cooldown.
When the chances to have a team fight in the next 8-12 seconds is low, activate it and
attack a random enemy in a safe position (usually a Minion) just to get some Mana.
During a team fight, use it on the focused enemy Hero
as additional burst damage, so that it will be easier
for your team to get a kill.
Remember that activating Frostmourne Hungers
will reset the cooldown of your Basic Attacks. Because of this, the best way
to use this Ability is to immediately activate it after a Basic Attack.
This trick will result in you landing 3 Basic Attacks in the time window of
2 Basic Attacks, increasing your burst damage.

abilities.title: Baseline Quest
abilities.text:
Arthas has a Baseline Quest which requires to last-hit enemy Minions or hit enemy
Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Frostmourne Hungers.
Each time you do one of these things, you will increase Arthas's Basic Attack damage
by a smaller amount and Frostmourne Hungers's bonus damage
by a bigger amount. There is no cap.
If you can safely hit enemy Heroes to get stacks, you should do so.
When that is not possible, you should lower the Health of an enemy Minion,
activate Frostmourne Hungers, and then last-hit them.
This way you will get at least 2 stacks per minute when sitting in a lane
or 4 stacks per minute when rotating from a lane to another.

Frost Strike (Level 4) Arthas Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.

Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

Summon Sindragosa (Level 10) Arthas Mana: 100 Cooldown: 100 seconds Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

13.text: Deathlord (Level 13) Arthas If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero. Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

Deathchill (Level 13) Arthas Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers. Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.
Biting Cold (Level 13) Arthas Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

16.text: Remorseless Winter (Level 16) Arthas Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.
Frostmourne Feeds (Level 16) Arthas Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.
Anti-Magic Shell (Level 16) Arthas Cooldown: 60 seconds Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

20.text: Legion of Northrend (Level 20) Arthas Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds. Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.
Absolute Zero (Level 20) Arthas Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

Death Pact (Level 20) Arthas Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions. Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.

Path of Frost (Level 20) Arthas Cooldown: 60 seconds Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds. When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 (+4% per level) damage.

Arthas's ARAM Build is designed to increase
his damage from the distance, his team's
burst damage, and his
self-sustain.
We find this Build particularly good against ranged Heroes.
Frost Presence at Level 1 makes both your
engage and your peeling reliable.
The burst damage comes from Shattered Armor
at Level 4 and Deathlord at Level 13.
When playing against Heroes with slow but heavy hitting Basic Attacks,
pick Rime at Level 1.
When playing against Heroes who deal a lot of damage with Abilities,
pick Anti-Magic Shell at Level 16.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
✔
Frost Presence
(Level 1)
Arthas
Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.
Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.
Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.
Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.
Frost Presence is a strong Talent that empowers
Howling Blast when hitting enemy Heroes with it.
After gaining 15 stacks, Howling Blast has more range
and hits enemies in its path, which results in a bigger area covered
AND in a double hit on enemies who are at the edge.
After gaining 30 stacks, Death Coil Slows
enemy Heroes hit, which could be used as a setup for
Howling Blast.
After completing the Quest, remember to change your playstyle from aiming
Howling Blast right on the enemy Hero
to aiming slightly beyond them when you are close enough to do so.
This way Howling Blast will cover a bigger area
and sometimes even hit more enemies than usual.
The additional range helps you to engage
from farther away, which is especially valuable against enemy Heroes
who like to play from the distance. The additional area covered
helps you to peel because it will be easier
to hit multiple enemy Heroes who are playing aggressively.
?
Borean Winds
(Level 1)
Arthas
After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.
Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.
Borean Winds is a strong Talent that increases
Arthas's Movement Speed after using Frozen Tempest
for a few seconds. This effect goes away when cancelling
Frozen Tempest. Furthermore, it makes
the Slow and the Attack Speed reduction
last slightly longer, and reduces its Mana cost.
?
Rime
(Level 1)
Arthas
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.
Passive: Arthas heals for 24 (+4% per level) Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.
Rime is a situational Talent that periodically gives
Physical Armor in the form of
Block charges. In addition to that,
Arthas passively heals over time while Stunned,
Rooted, or Slowed.
Block charges are especially valuable
when facing Heroes with slow but heavy-hitting Basic Attacks (such as Hanzo) and
terrible when playing against Heroes with fast-hitting Basic Attacks (D.Va,
Genji, Kharazim, Lúcio, Tassadar, Tracer,
and Tychus). Heroes with Clones (for example Nova) can consume them faster
too, however, it is generally not a problem because their AI will not always target you.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
✔
Shattered Armor
(Level 4)
Arthas
Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.
Shattered Armor is a strong Talent that causes
Howling Blast to reduce the Armor
of enemy Heroes hit, amplifying the damage done by you and the rest of your team.
Since Armor reduction effects do not stack, this Talent
is less impactful when another Hero in your team can already reduce the
Armor of enemy Heroes, however, it can still be useful
in the early game if their effect comes from a Talent
that is only pickable in the late game.
While it has synergy with Frost Presence at Level 1,
it is not a strong requirement and can therefore be picked without it as well.
Similarly, even though it does not have a direct synergy with it,
Deathchill at Level 13 can be picked together
to further increase your burst damage.
?
Icy Talons
(Level 4)
Arthas
Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.
Icy Talons is a good Talent that provides
a powerful Attack Speed buff when fighting against Heroes who cannot
get out of Frozen Tempest with ease (such as Artanis).
This bonus does ramp up faster if multiple enemy Heroes are being hit
by Frozen Tempest at the same time.
We find this Talent particularly useful when playing against melee Heroes
without mobility tools to avoid Arthas
and against teams without burst damage, otherwise
you will not have enough targets to make in ramp up in a reasonable time
and you may get killed before getting value from it.
?
Frost Strike
(Level 4)
Arthas
Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.
Frost Strike is a good Talent which causes
Basic Attacks empowered by Frostmourne Hungers
to deal area of effect damage
in the form of Spell Damage
and Slow enemy Heroes hit.
We find this Talent useful when you want to increase your
waveclear. After picking it, use Basic Attacks
empowered by Frostmourne Hungers on the Wizard Minion
in the middle of a wave of Minions. This way you will be able to damage
all nearby Minions with it.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
✔
Immortal Coil
(Level 7)
Arthas
Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.
Immortal Coil is a strong Talent that empowers
Death Coil differently depending on whether
it is being used defensively or offensively. When used on enemy Heroes,
Arthas still receives healing (with travel time). When self-cast,
Arthas receives more healing (without travel time)
and Death Coil's cooldown is reduced.
?
Rune Tap
(Level 7)
Arthas
Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.
Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.
Rune Tap is a good Talent that increases
Arthas's survivability while dueling or in prolonged team fights
by making every third Basic Attack heal him for a percentage of his maximum Health.
In addition to that, Arthas's maximum Health is passively increased based on
how many stacks of Frostmourne Hungers you have.
If you prepare 2 stacks by hitting Minions before fighting against
enemy Heroes, the first Rune Tap activation will
happen sooner, so you will get slightly more healing early in the fight.
The healing does not go off if you are full Health, however, it still
goes off if most of the healing would be wasted due to overhealing.
Do not overthink that in team fights but keep that in mind while laning.
The healing via Basic Attacks has synergy with Frostmourne Hungers
that resets the cooldown of your next Basic Attack, with Icy Talons
at Level 4 that increases your Attack Speed, and with Frostmourne Feeds
at Level 16 that reduces the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers
by a considerable amount. The bonus maximum Health provided by this Talent
can be increased by picking Death Pact at Level 20,
which results into even more healing when it goes off.
?
Icebound Fortitude
(Level 7)
Arthas
Cooldown: 35 seconds
Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.
Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.
Icebound Fortitude is a situational Talent with a
relatively short cooldown that can be activated to gain Armor,
remove Roots and Slows from Arthas
and reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots,
and Slows. All these effects combined together increase
Arthas's survivability against most crowd control effects
and burst damage. The cooldown is reduced every time
Howling Blast hits an enemy Hero.
Arthas does not have mobility to quickly get out of danger.
When threatened by burst damage or healing reduction effects,
you should pick this Talent to make Arthas harder to kill. While this Talent
does not directly help against healing reduction effects, having more
Armor is helpful against them and the alternative
Talents in this Tier are all healing-based.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Army of the Dead
(Level 10)
Arthas
Charges: 6
Recharge Time: 18 seconds
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.
Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.
Army of the Dead is a strong Heroic Ability that
heavily increases Arthas's survivability in team fights when activated
with many charges available and reactivated
to heal by sacrificing Ghouls.
You can use this Heroic Ability to tank enemy Structures while
pushing or to spawn Ghouls in front of enemy Heroes who rely
on skillshots to deal damage (notably Li-Ming).
This way you will take less damage and maybe even reduce the damage taken
by allied Heroes who are standing on your side or behind you.
Avoid picking this Heroic Ability when playing against Heroes
who can quickly kill all Ghouls
or when the enemy team has healing reduction effects
(for example Mortal Wound by Xul)
because they will be able to deny the additional healing provided.
✔
Summon Sindragosa
(Level 10)
Arthas
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.
Summon Sindragosa is a strong Heroic Ability that
gives some damage and crowd control. In particular,
it allows Arthas to engage from the distance, even when
enemy Heroes are too far for being hit with Howling Blast,
and to disable enemy Structures when pushing or diving.
Pick this Heroic Ability when you do not need the additional survivability provided by
Army of the Dead and your team wants to play aggressively.
If you are playing on a Map where games rarely get to Level 20 and your team
has a solid lead, you can capitalize on it by using Summon Sindragosa
right after winning a team fight or Objective to get an early Keep.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
✔
Deathlord
(Level 13)
Arthas
If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.
Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.
Deathlord is a good Talent which empowers
Death Coil when used offensively, dealing
0.5% more damage for each percentage of Health missing on Arthas
(for example, at 50% Health it deals 25% more damage). When used on
an enemy Hero, it also launches a second Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.
When using Death Coil on Arthas, this Talent
does nothing.
If you have Immortal Coil at Level 7,
using Death Coil on enemy Heroes will also heal
Arthas. This healing is doubled if there is another enemy Hero nearby.
If you are in desperate need of healing, you should still prefer to
self-cast Death Coil because it gives almost
as much healing as hitting 2 enemy Heroes (without travel time)
and Death Coil's cooldown reduction.
?
Deathchill
(Level 13)
Arthas
Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.
Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.
Deathchill is a good Talent which increases
the damage done by Howling Blast and the duration
of its Root effect. The damage is increased based on
how many stacks of Frostmourne Hungers you have
and based on how much Health enemy Heroes are missing. The duration
of its Root effect is only increased based on how much
Health enemy Heroes are missing.
When trying to burst down enemy Heroes,
the damage bonus can be made more lethal by combining this Talent
with Shattered Armor at Level 4, although
it does not have a direct synergy with it, and can be increased
by picking Death Pact at Level 20.
?
Biting Cold
(Level 13)
Arthas
Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.
Biting Cold is a strong Talent that increases
Frozen Tempest's damage when fighting against Heroes who cannot
get out of Frozen Tempest with ease (such as Artanis).
This bonus does NOT ramp up faster if multiple enemies are being hit
by Frozen Tempest at the same time.
We find this Talent particularly useful when playing against melee Heroes
without mobility tools to avoid Arthas
and against teams without burst damage, otherwise
you may get killed before getting value from it.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
✔
Remorseless Winter
(Level 16)
Arthas
Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.
Remorseless Winter is a strong Talent that, when enemy Heroes
stay too long inside Frozen Tempest, heals Arthas for each
enemy Hero hit and Roots them, drastically increasing
Arthas's crowd control capabilities
against low-mobility Heroes (such as Cassia).
This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds per target.
?
Frostmourne Feeds
(Level 16)
Arthas
Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.
Frostmourne Feeds is a good Talent which reduces
the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers and makes
Basic Attacks empowered by it heal Arthas for a portion of the damage dealt.
Thanks to the cooldown reduction provided, this Talent has synergy with
Frost Strike at Level 4,
Rune Tap at Level 7, and
Death Pact at Level 20.
?
Anti-Magic Shell
(Level 16)
Arthas
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.
Anti-Magic Shell is a situational Talent that allows
Arthas to survive burst damage in the form of both
Spell Damage and percent-based damage.
Activating this Talent allows to mitigate the huge amount of damage that
notable Arthas's counter picks (for example Jaina) can deal to him,
although its effectiveness can be partially reduced by healing reduction effects.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Arthas
talent_pages.text:
?
Legion of Northrend
(Level 20)
Arthas
Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.
Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.
Legion of Northrend is a decent Talent that
increases Arthas's survivability by reducing the charge
cooldown of Army of the Dead and his damage and utility
by spawning an additional Ghoul per charge. Ghouls spawned this way do not
follow Arthas but attack nearby enemies. You will NOT get more healing
from this Talent because the additional Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.
✔
Absolute Zero
(Level 20)
Arthas
Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.
Absolute Zero is a strong Talent
that greatly increases the strength of Summon Sindragosa
by adding a relatively long Root before the already powerful
Slow effect, allowing you to engage
from farther away and/or to keep enemy Heroes locked in place for longer.
Considering that Summon Sindragosa already has a high range,
the additional distance covered is not indispensable. That said,
sometimes it may help you disable enemy Structures from the distance
and/or catch enemy Heroes that want to avoid a team fight at all costs.
Avoid picking this Talent against
Heroes who have a way to free up multiple Heroes from a Root effect
(for example Nature's Cure by Malfurion).
Note that cleansing the Root
will also prevent the Slow from being applied.
?
Death Pact
(Level 20)
Arthas
Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions.
Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.
Death Pact is a good Talent which instantly double
your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, prevents you
from gaining stacks by killing Minions or hitting Heroes with it,
but allows you to gain stacks by killing Heroes.
We recommend picking this Talent when you want to increase your damage output
and you have at least 40 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers,
otherwise you will not get enough value out of it.
Since it increases your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers,
this Talent has synergy with Rune Tap at Level 7
and Deathchill at Level 13.
?
Path of Frost
(Level 20)
Arthas
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.
When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 (+4% per level) damage.
Path of Frost is a strong Talent which can be
activated to instantly summon your Mount with increased Movement Speed
for up to 5 seconds. During this effect, damage taken does not dismount
Arthas and Slows cannot reduce Arthas's Movement Speed.
When the effect expires or Arthas dismounts, nearby enemies
are Slowed and take damage.
